about_the_game:
Her email was unsettling. Why does she insist so much that I come to Tokyo?

Here, everyone feels like a shadow of themselves.

They talk about a boundary between reality and… something else.

It sounds insane, but my nightmares feel closer every day. Maybe I should find something to help me sleep. I have to find her — quickly — and never set foot here again.

And one more thing: ghosts don’t exist… right?

  • In this horror-adventure game, you play as Cam, searching for her sister, who mysteriously vanished in an enigmatic suburb of Tokyo.

  • Explore the city freely, uncover a deep and unsettling story, gather clues, and unravel the secrets of the Membrane.

  • Traverse a dangerous world using only a single action button. Cam cannot fight the ghosts and creatures lurking around every corner — you can only run, hide, and survive.

  • Experience a unique blend of adventure, point-and-click, and horror, delivering an original and unconventional gameplay experience.

  • Immerse yourself in hand-drawn retro visuals inspired by cyberpunk classics and Japanese horror films and games.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains body horror, flashing lights, graphic gore, and blood.
It also deals with sensitive themes including drug use, prostitution, sexual abuse, mental illness, homosexuality, and suicide.

short_description: I had lost all contact with my sister when she suddenly called me from a Tokyo suburb consumed by the Membrane — a curse that blurs the line between nightmares and reality. Fight shadows and your own fears in this psychological horror exploration game.
